summary.text: Lisa Willner is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 35 who has served since January 1, 2019, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Republican Bret Shultz.
A psychologist and Bellarmine University faculty member, she previously served on the Jefferson County Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Willner graduated from Jeffersonville High School in 1977 and earned a bachelor's degree from Yale University in 1981, followed by a master's degree in 1990 and a Ph.D. in 1992 from the California School of Professional Psychology.
She has served as executive director of the Kentucky Psychological Association and has served on the faculty at Bellarmine University since 2000.
Willner held the Jefferson County Public Schools Board of Education District 6 seat from 2014 to 2018, and then succeeded Democrat Jim Wayne in the state House.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Health and Family Services, Postsecondary Education, and Primary and Secondary Education committees.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as the only licensed mental health professional in the Kentucky Legislature and said she focuses on affordability, mental health and what she called corporate tax breaks.
